analogy.rationale: PAH, TH, TPH1 and NOS3 are enzymes in neurotransmitter/cofactor biosynthesis that are poorly expressed or non-rate-limiting in these cancer cell lines, so a stimulant should elicit little transcriptional response; the closest analogs are other modulators of the same monoamine/nitric oxide pathways.
